name: Lingchen Zeng
statement: My purpose is not to fabricate alternatives, but to document the world exactly as it exists.

Through narrative simulations and unfiltered photography, I remove the distance between the observer and the overlooked. My work is not a surrender to the reality but a direct confrontation with the present.
I capture the absolute tension between structural order and raw chaos, preserving a grounded, uncompromising reflection of the human experience.
